name: fenix
description: MMORPG web inspirado en Ultima Online y el motor Sphere

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fenix/server" "npm run dev -w @fenix/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fenix/client && npm run build -w @fenix/server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
